session_end_persistence_policy.completion_definition: A batch is not completed until a GitHub commit SHA exists.
session_end_persistence_policy.rule: Persist every completed batch to GitHub before ending a session, then update CHECKPOINT.json and HANDOFF.md with the exact next resume point.

cp_status.note: CP reconstruction is finished. Do not resume CP translation unless a new source version requires an update.

dll_status.note: DLL translation and full structural audit are complete. Do not resume DLL translation unless a new source version requires an update.

remaining_release_blockers: Assemble CP and DLL canonical localization into the installation-ready Vietnamese folder structure.
Verify final package paths and JSON validity.
Build the release archive containing localization files only.

resume_target.priority_1: Determine exact install paths for the CP and DLL vi.json files from the original mod structure.
resume_target.priority_2: Assemble the localization-only package from canonical CP and DLL translations.
resume_target.priority_3: Validate the archive contents and publish/store the finished release artifact in the repo.
